pair.searchQuery: Early-stage tech founders building for luxury (AI, Web3, AR/VR) – seeking companies for an accelerator program. Seed/Series A focus. Prefer personalization/recommendation expertise.

userContactFile.positioning:
I’m building the future of luxury – one strategic partnership at a time. As the Founder & Principal at Kairos Collective, I specialize in forging impactful collaborations between emerging technology companies and established luxury brands. I see a massive opportunity for innovation within the luxury sector, but it requires a nuanced understanding of brand heritage, consumer expectations, and the power of seamless integration. 

Kairos Collective isn't just about slapping AI onto a handbag; it’s about fundamentally reimagining the luxury experience. We help brands leverage technologies like AI-powered personalization, Web3 authentication, and immersive retail experiences to cultivate deeper customer relationships and unlock new revenue streams. 

We’ve recently secured pilot programs with two prominent California-based luxury hospitality groups to implement AI-driven concierge services, resulting in a 15% increase in guest satisfaction and a 10% boost in upsell revenue. We are also advising a leading sustainable fashion brand on integrating blockchain technology for supply chain transparency and authentication. Currently, I'm actively fundraising for a highly curated accelerator program focused on ‘Tech & Luxury’ – supporting early-stage startups developing solutions specifically for the high-end market. I’m seeking strategic investors who share my vision and understand the unique dynamics of this exciting intersection. I'm also open to conversations with luxury brands actively exploring technological innovation and tech companies seeking access to the luxury consumer market.
userContactFile.lookingFor:
I'm actively seeking connections and opportunities in the following areas:

• **Investors:** Angel investors and venture capital firms with a focus on early-stage startups, particularly those interested in the intersection of technology and luxury. Seed to Series A funding rounds are of most interest.
• **Luxury Brand Executives:** Heads of Innovation, Digital Transformation, and Marketing at established luxury brands (fashion, hospitality, automotive, etc.). I’m looking to explore potential partnership opportunities and demonstrate the value of integrating innovative technologies.
• **Tech Founders:** Founders of early-stage startups developing solutions specifically for the luxury market (AI, Web3, AR/VR, personalization, supply chain, etc.). I’m scouting for companies to participate in my upcoming accelerator program.
• **Mentors & Advisors:** Experienced entrepreneurs and industry leaders who can provide guidance and support as I scale Kairos Collective and launch the accelerator program.
• **Specific Expertise Needed:** AI/ML specialists with experience in personalization and recommendation engines; Web3 developers with a focus on blockchain authentication and NFT applications; experts in luxury brand strategy and consumer behavior.
userContactFile.introPreferences:
• When making introductions, please emphasize my background in both design *and* technology – it’s a key differentiator.
• Focus on the value proposition of Kairos Collective: bridging the gap between tech innovation and luxury brand integrity.
• Avoid framing introductions as simply ‘tech demos’ – emphasize the potential for strategic partnerships and long-term value creation.
• I prefer concise, targeted introductions with a clear ‘ask’ or desired outcome.
• Please include a brief overview of the individual’s background and relevant experience in your introduction.
• I am happy to jump on a quick call to discuss potential connections beforehand.
userContactFile.personalPreferences: Email is best for initial contact. I'm responsive on LinkedIn but prefer to keep those conversations more professional. Quick scheduling links are appreciated.
userContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: Please send a calendar invite with a clear agenda. I prefer to be included in meetings proactively if the topic is directly relevant to my work. I am generally available for 30-60 minute meetings.
userContactFile.background:
• **Founder & Principal, Kairos Collective** (2021 – Present)
    – Leading all aspects of partnership development, strategic consulting, and program management for clients in the luxury and technology sectors.
    – Secured and managed pilot programs with leading hospitality and fashion brands, demonstrating quantifiable ROI through technology integration.
    – Developed a proprietary framework for assessing technology-market fit within the luxury landscape.
    – Currently leading fundraising efforts for a ‘Tech & Luxury’ accelerator program.
• **Creative Director & Founder, Atelier Lumière** (2015 – 2021)
    – Established and managed a bespoke textile design studio specializing in high-end fabrics for interior design and fashion.
    – Cultivated strong relationships with luxury retailers and interior designers, resulting in consistent repeat business and national recognition.
    – Oversaw all aspects of design, production, and client management, demonstrating strong entrepreneurial skills.
    – Successfully navigated the challenges of scaling a creative business, including supply chain management and quality control.
• **Education:**
    – **Master of Business Administration (MBA), Stanford Graduate School of Business** (2013 – 2015)
        – Focus: Entrepreneurship & Innovation
    – **Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA), Rhode Island School of Design** (2009 – 2013)
        – Major: Textile Design
• **Certifications:**
    – Certified Innovation Strategist (2022)
userContactFile.locationAvailability: I am based in the San Francisco Bay Area and frequently travel throughout California. I am always open to connecting in person and value the richness of face-to-face interactions.
userContactFile.notes:
• Sofia is a *very* strong networker – she’s built a remarkably robust network in both the tech and luxury worlds. 
• She’s incredibly articulate and passionate about her work. Be prepared for a detailed and enthusiastic conversation.
• She mentioned in our last call that she’s particularly interested in companies applying AI to enhance the in-store luxury shopping experience. 
• She’s cautious about over-hyped tech – she prioritizes solutions that deliver tangible value and align with brand identity. 
• Data accuracy check: Double-check the funding status of the accelerator program before making introductions – it’s still in the initial stages.
• Action item: Share the profile of [Investor Name] with Sofia – they have a strong track record of investing in consumer tech.

matchContactFile.positioning:
I'm building Aura, a personalized wellness platform designed to cut through the noise and deliver genuinely effective routines. We're moving beyond generic wellness advice and leveraging AI to understand individual needs – factoring in everything from sleep patterns and activity levels to dietary preferences and even subtle bio-signatures. The core value proposition is simple: *personalized* wellness that actually works. 

We’re targeting the ‘conscious consumer’ – individuals aged 25-45 who are actively seeking to improve their well-being but are overwhelmed by the sheer volume of information and products available. They’re digitally fluent, value authenticity, and are willing to invest in solutions that deliver tangible results. We’re not selling a ‘quick fix’; we’re offering a sustainable pathway to holistic health.

Recently, we’ve completed a successful beta launch with a cohort of 500 users, achieving a 78% retention rate and an average user engagement time of 45 minutes per day. This validates our core hypothesis: that personalization is the key to unlocking lasting behavioral change. We’re currently focused on refining our AI algorithms, expanding our data integrations, and preparing for a Series A funding round. My focus is on building a truly impactful company that empowers individuals to take control of their well-being. I believe we're solving a critical problem in a rapidly growing market, and I'm excited about the potential to make a real difference in people’s lives.  I'm particularly proud of the team we've assembled - a blend of experienced AI engineers, behavioral scientists, and passionate wellness advocates.
matchContactFile.lookingFor:
* **Strategic Investors:** Seed/Series A investors with a proven track record in the health & wellness or AI/ML space.  Specifically seeking investors who understand the nuances of consumer-facing technology and are aligned with our long-term vision.
* **Data Partnerships:** Companies with access to valuable health & wellness data (wearables, genetic testing, etc.).  Looking for opportunities to integrate data streams to enhance our personalization algorithms.
* **AI/ML Advisors:** Experienced professionals who can provide guidance on scaling AI-driven platforms and optimizing our machine learning models.  Prefer individuals with experience in recommendation engines or personalized content delivery.
* **Mentors:** Seasoned entrepreneurs who have successfully scaled consumer tech companies.  Seeking advice on navigating the challenges of rapid growth and building a sustainable business.
* **Potential Board Members:** Individuals with relevant industry experience and a strong network.
* **(Avoid) VCs solely focused on 'metaverse' or 'web3' – not a fit for our current focus.
matchContactFile.introPreferences:
* **Ideal Introductions:** VCs specializing in healthtech, AI, or consumer brands. Founders of successful wellness or personalization platforms. Data science leaders at companies like Fitbit or 23andMe.
* **Hard Requirements:** Individuals with a demonstrable track record of success in scaling consumer-facing businesses.
* **Soft Preferences:** Individuals who are passionate about wellness and have a strong understanding of consumer psychology.
* **Do NOT introduce:** Salespeople pitching unrelated products or services. Individuals with a purely financial focus (e.g., tax advisors). People who haven’t thoroughly researched Aura.
matchContactFile.personalPreferences: Emeka prefers to connect initially via LinkedIn or email. He responds best to concise and well-articulated messages. He's relatively active on Twitter (@EmekaCastillo – but mostly shares industry articles).
matchContactFile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: Emeka prefers virtual meetings initially to assess fit. He is generally available for meetings during Pacific Standard Time business hours, but requires at least 24 hours' notice.
matchContactFile.background:
* **Bloom (Founder & CEO, 2018 – 2022):** Led the company from inception to acquisition by L'Oréal. Oversaw all aspects of the business, including product development, marketing, sales, and operations. Successfully scaled Bloom to over 500,000 active customers through a data-driven, influencer-focused growth strategy.
* **Growth Architect, Zenith Cosmetics (2016 – 2018):** Spearheaded the development and implementation of digital marketing campaigns that resulted in a 30% increase in online sales within the first year. Led a team of marketing specialists and managed a budget of $2M.
* **Marketing Manager, Stellar Beauty (2014 – 2016):** Managed the brand’s social media presence and developed content marketing strategies that increased brand awareness and engagement.  Successfully launched several new product lines.
* **Education: MBA, Stanford Graduate School of Business (2012 – 2014); BA, Economics, University of California, Berkeley (2008 – 2012).**
* **Key Skills:** Digital Marketing, Brand Building, Growth Hacking, AI/ML (basic understanding), Data Analytics, Leadership, Team Management, Strategic Planning, Consumer Psychology.
matchContactFile.locationAvailability: Emeka is currently based in San Francisco, California, and is open to travel for strategic meetings. He is not currently considering relocation, preferring to build Aura within the existing Bay Area ecosystem.
matchContactFile.notes:
Emeka is highly analytical and data-driven. He’s a fast mover and expects the same from those he interacts with. He’s very focused on building a strong team and fostering a positive company culture. He's still relatively early in the Aura journey, so he’s open to feedback but has a clear vision. He’s passionate about wellness and genuinely believes in the power of personalization. 

* He’s currently reading 'The Psychology of Habit' and is heavily influenced by behavioral economics.
* He recently spoke at the HealthTech Summit in San Francisco.
* He’s particularly sensitive to pitches that lack a clear understanding of the consumer landscape.  Avoid generic ‘disruptive’ language.
* He’s open to informal coffee chats but prefers to keep initial conversations focused and efficient. His time is valuable.

qc.judge_reasoning: While both individuals are Stanford MBA alumni based in the Bay Area with a focus on AI-driven personalization, their core business models do not align. Person A is building an accelerator for luxury-focused tech startups, whereas Person B is a founder of a wellness platform who explicitly avoids Web3/metaverse-focused entities and is seeking healthtech-specific investors or data partners. There is no clear value exchange here, as Person B's wellness platform does not fit the 'luxury' vertical Person A is curating for her accelerator.
